title: Chestplate Elytra
description: Adds a Glide enchantment that gives any chestplate elytra-like gliding — same physics, same firework boost.
body:
# Glide Enchantment

Turn any chestplate into an elytra. Glide Enchantment adds a single new enchantment — **Glide** — that gives chestplates the exact same flight mechanics as a vanilla elytra.

## Features

- **New enchantment: Glide** — applies to any chestplate (iron, gold, diamond, netherite, leather, chainmail, turtle shell, and modded chest armor that supports enchantments).
- **Identical to vanilla elytra** — jump while falling to start gliding, hold space to glide, use firework rockets to boost forward. Same physics, same controls.
- **Obtainable normally** — appears in the enchanting table, on enchanted books from loot/trades, and can be applied via an anvil.
- **Server-friendly** — works on dedicated servers and singleplayer. No client-side requirements beyond having the mod installed.

## How to get it

- **Enchanting table** — place a chestplate + lapis and look for *Glide* in the offered enchantments.
- **Anvil** — combine a chestplate with an enchanted book containing Glide.
- **Creative / commands** — give yourself an enchanted book directly:
  ```
  /give @s enchanted_book[stored_enchantments={"glide_enchant:glide":1}]
  ```

## How to use

1. Enchant any chestplate with **Glide**.
2. Equip the chestplate.
3. Jump off something tall.
4. Press jump again mid-air to start gliding.
5. (Optional) Use a firework rocket while gliding to boost forward — exactly like a real elytra.

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependencies:** Fabric API
- **Side:** required on both client and server (or just on the server for multiplayer; client-only also works in singleplayer)

## Why?

Late-game elytras are gated behind the End. This enchantment lets you bring elytra-style movement to any chestplate you've already enchanted, so you can keep your favorite armor and still fly.
